desc: 深黑舞台质感、重低音声场、旋转耳罩与久戴舒适的头戴蓝牙耳机套图
name: 深黑重低音久戴舒适头戴耳机款

shots.intent: 首屏以深黑肌理与低角度动态构图在一秒内建立高端声学气场，承接点击。
shots.textZone: upper-right block: short English-style eyebrow line plus a large headline, both in #FFFFFF

shots.intent: 用金属铰链与耳罩面板的微距细节证明结构与做工，让可旋转设计可信。
shots.textZone: bottom third dark band #0A0A0A with white headline and one short sub-line, left-aligned

shots.intent: 以发光芯片视觉加三列数据对比，把连接与续航优势量化，击退对杂牌芯片的顾虑。
shots.textZone: center headline plus three evenly spaced stat columns, each column one large number figure with one short label line, thin divider lines in #FFFFFF

shots.intent: 侧影悬浮加同心放射线制造声波意象，一屏讲清降噪这一核心卖点。
shots.textZone: top-center headline in #2D2D2D with one short centered sub-line below

shots.intent: 驱动单元微距与功能图标行并用，把频响与声学配置转译为可感的能量画面。
shots.textZone: upper band: row of four dark circular badges with short labels; middle: one centered white headline between the bands

shots.intent: 把产品放进打碟台真实使用情境，直观展示旋转耳罩与延展线材的工作自由度。
shots.textZone: upper third dark area: white headline with two short sub-lines, left-aligned

shots.intent: 亮橙撞色配人像颈部佩戴，把轻与软的久戴舒适感转成可代入的画面。
shots.textZone: left column: small eyebrow line, large white headline, two short benefit lines, all left-aligned

shots.intent: 白底正面机位加斑马纹参数表，一次消除尺寸、续航、连接距离等疑问。
shots.textZone: top-center headline in #2D2D2D; below the product a two-column spec table, label column left in #2D2D2D, value column right in #6E6E6E

shots.intent: 同机位同光并列深黑与银灰两配色，锁定选择、减少比价流失。
shots.textZone: one short color label under each variant in #2D2D2D, centered under its variant

shots.intent: 深黑台面配橙色光晕与行动按钮，用套图一贯的氛围完成最后转化收口。
shots.textZone: left column: large white headline, one rounded CTA button in #F26F21 with a short label, one trust line below, all left-aligned
